title: Tackle and Gear Inventory
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch event=gear
| stats latest(quantity) as qty, latest(condition) as condition by item
| where qty<min_stock OR condition="worn"
| sort item
description: Tracks your lures, lines, and gear, flagging what is worn or running low before the next trip.
value: Discovering you are out of the right lure at the water is a wasted trip; an inventory check prevents it.
implementation: Log gear stock into `index=personal`; flag low or worn items.
visualization: Table of tackle needing restock or replacement.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your fishing gear and flags what is worn or running low before your next trip.
